products.name: CrowdStrike Charlotte AI
products.note: Security operations AI; threat detection; autonomous response; high-privilege access

profile_text.body:
CrowdStrike is a publicly traded global cybersecurity company (NASDAQ: CRWD, CIK 0001535527) that describes itself as a leader in stopping breaches through an AI-native approach. Its core offering is the CrowdStrike Falcon Platform, a cloud-native platform that the company says is designed to protect endpoints, cloud workloads, identities, and data. The site frames the platform as addressing three critical fronts in what it calls the AI era, covering AI-powered threat exploitation, cloud breaches, and the security of AI systems themselves, including AI model scanning and an AI security dashboard.

The company's tracked AI product is CrowdStrike Charlotte AI, categorized under Security and Identity AI. It is described as serving security operations functions including threat detection, autonomous response, and high-privilege access management. The broader Falcon Platform is also positioned to counter adversaries who use AI to accelerate attacks, and to provide unified agent and agentless protection for cloud environments.
